description: This file defines the ADODB2_oci8 class, a PHP class for Oracle database schema management within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes methods for type mapping, creating databases, altering tables, managing sequences and triggers, and handling SQL for indexes and comments.

classes.name: ADODB2_oci8
classes.description: A PHP class for Oracle (OCI8) database schema management, extending ADODB_DataDict.

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Maps PHP data types to Oracle-specific data types.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual Oracle data type for a given meta type code.

methods.name: CreateDatabase
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to create a new Oracle user/schema.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to add columns to a table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to modify existing table columns.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _DropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop auto-increment sequences.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffix for column definitions, including defaults and constraints.

methods.name: _Triggers
methods.description: Creates Oracle sequences and triggers to emulate auto-increment behavior.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating or dropping indexes.

methods.name: GetCommentSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to retrieve column comments.

methods.name: SetCommentSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to set column comments.
